name: elagoht/cdnpurge
description: A collage plugin that purges a CDN's copies of the pages collage invalidates.
setup: Nothing is purged until a CDN is named: set `"cloudflare": {"zoneID": …, "apiTokenEnv": "CF_API_TOKEN"}` or `"webhook": {"url": …}` in this plugin's section of `plugins-config.json`. URLs are made absolute under `Config.BaseURL` (`BASE_URL`) or an origin resolver's origins; without either the application does not start.

config.description: A collage plugin that purges a CDN's copies of the pages collage invalidates.

backoff.description: Backoff is the wait before the first retry, doubled before each one after it. A 429's Retry-After, when longer, is honoured instead. Default "1s".

cloudflare.description: Cloudflare purges a Cloudflare zone. At least one of Cloudflare and Webhook is required; with both, both are purged.

apiTokenEnv.description: APITokenEnv names the environment variable holding an API token with the Zone → Cache Purge permission for the zone. It or APIToken is required; when set, it wins over APIToken.

batchSize.description: BatchSize is how many URLs one purge request carries. Default 30, which is what every Cloudflare plan accepts; an Enterprise zone takes more.

endpoint.description: Endpoint is the API's base URL. Default "https://api.cloudflare.com".

zoneID.description: ZoneID is the zone's identifier, on the zone's overview page. Required.

inDevelopment.description: InDevelopment purges from a development server too, which otherwise purges nothing.

retries.description: Retries is how many times a request the CDN answered 429 or 5xx, or that did not reach it, is tried again. Default 4; negative is an error.

timeout.description: Timeout bounds one request to the CDN. Default "10s".

webhook.description: Webhook posts the URLs to an endpoint of your own, or of a CDN whose API takes a list of URLs.

batchSize.description: BatchSize is how many URLs one request carries. Default: all of them.

tokenEnv.description: TokenEnv names the environment variable holding a token sent as "Authorization: Bearer <token>". Optional; when set, it wins over Token, and an empty variable is an error.

window.description: Window is how long invalidations are collected before they are sent, so a burst of them is one request. Default "2s".
